profile:
COMPANY NAME: Herbalife
INDUSTRY: Health & Wellness / Nutrition
PRODUCT OR SERVICE: A global provider of nutritional supplements, meal replacements, and health products, including a direct sales business opportunity platform.
TARGET CUSTOMERS: Consumers seeking weight management, fitness, and daily nutrition support, as well as individuals interested in starting a direct sales business.
PRICING MODEL: Enterprise / Direct Sales (Product purchase via independent distributors)
KEY FEATURES: 
- Comprehensive product lines for fitness, performance, healthy weight, and daily nutrition
- Direct sales business opportunity with "Wellness Rewards" program
- Personalized supplement options (e.g., Bioniq GO)
- Scientifically researched formulas with high-quality ingredients
- Community-driven wellness platform
UNIQUE SELLING POINTS: Over 45 years of history, rigorous scientific research, high-quality ingredients, and a strong sense of community spirit.
TONE & POSITIONING: Premium / Community-focused / Empowering
